prompt: Gold sells hot soup on a cold day
title: Hot Soup Day
irony: Stingy Gold's hot soup leaves everyone out in the cold until he gives the first bowl away free.

beats.title: The street wakes
beats.summary: Frost paints the diner windows while Gold's big soup pot steams.

beats.title: The setup
beats.summary: Green wants hot soup but recites soup facts instead of tasting, while Gold counts coins.

beats.title: The setup builds
beats.summary: Purple's truck trumpets free frosty treats across the road and the line drifts away.

beats.title: The hook
beats.summary: The diner crowd chants for hot soup, stomping cold feet together.

beats.title: The problem
beats.summary: Green drags Navy to Purple's truck, Silver slips and spills free samples in the snow.

beats.title: The problem builds
beats.summary: Silver tumbles with Gold's sample tray while Gold shouts about extra napkins.

beats.title: The hook again
beats.summary: The cold crowd chants again, breath puffing over empty bowls.

beats.title: The turn
beats.summary: Gold holds the warm pot and remembers paying for Silver's soup on rainy days.

beats.title: The turn deepens
beats.summary: Gold ladles a free bowl for shivering Green while Pink smiles warmly.

beats.title: The hook, grown
beats.summary: Gold sings the turned line, offering free warmth that brings everyone inside.

beats.title: Settle down
beats.summary: The diner glows warm as Purple parks quietly and everyone shares soup together.
